fields.Name: Predictive Studio Gates — Scoring
fields.Description: The PR 4 scoring gates: G5.1 (the R1 model on a copy table with DistanceZ renamed: a binding on the copy is refused at save, and a no-binding scoring call over it is refused naming the scope entity, 0 rows), G5.2 (/predict refuses a renamed feature naming it and a legacy model with no stored schema), G5.3 (20 bound Score Record Set calls on the R1 model leave 20 scoring-run rows and every written score's lineage joins to its run and model), G5.4 (every Model row of a C1 scoring run carries and resolves its four lineage fields), G5.5 (an all-null feature column in the W1 s42 scoring input is refused naming the column, 0 scores) and G3.9 (the W9 multiclass probability shown for the named class equals the artifact's predict_proba column, 20 of 20). Needs MJAPI (STORAGE_LOCAL_ROOT set, PREDICTIVE_STUDIO_SIDECAR_URL at the truth sidecar), the truth sidecar running (pnpm run truth:sidecar, which writes .run/sidecar.url and .run/sidecar.pid) and `pnpm run truth:provision` then `pnpm run truth:load-c1` done (the second with MJAPI running: it loads the C1 corpus and declares the truth suite's immutable fields; restart MJAPI after it); the mj test process needs STORAGE_LOCAL_ROOT too. Run with: MJ_INTEGRATION_TEST=1 RUN_MUTATION_TESTS=1 pnpm mj test suite "Predictive Studio Gates — Scoring"
